title: The one-way finality of crossing Coldpass ('A companion's grief left unfinished there stays unfinished unless you walk back for it') is only stated once you're standing at the Pass Gate itself — by then three companions' personal grief-sites (Fenmarch for Osk, a return trip to Thornwold for Lys, Hollowbrook's Keepers' Hall for Vell) are already a long walk behind you with no earlier heads-up to plan around it.
